title: Surface interrupted TTS as project attention
description: Propagate an interrupted persisted TTS job into the project-level Voice Generation needs_attention state while keeping the existing explicit failed-segment retry lifecycle valid.
businessContext: V1 maps internal failures to a clear top-level action. After restart, the TTS job is failed and retryable, but the project can still report Voice Generation as running until the user retries a segment.
dependencies: existing voice-generation StageRun and segment retry IPC
acceptanceCriteria: A recovered interrupted TTS job marks its project Voice Generation stage needs_attention with a safe reason and an explicit Voice retry action.
Startup still makes no provider-backed TTS call and does not fabricate a completed stage or artifact.
Retrying a failed segment explicitly restores the Voice Generation stage to running before the provider call so successful completion can transition it to needs_review.
Focused persistence checks, typecheck, and diff checks pass.
verificationCommands: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/db/test/persistence.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/ttsJobService.test.ts
humanEscalationConditions: The existing StageRun cannot remain safely retryable while the project exposes needs_attention.
Making retry explicit requires a new provider or persistence mechanism.
